card.name: Drug interaction text, naming the other drug
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction passages where the interacting second drug is about to be named or is partway through its name. Also linking words such as of, with and the after verbs like increase, interfere or interaction.

modes.label: Partway through the affected drug's name
modes.description: Inside the name of a drug whose level or effect is changed by another drug.

modes.label: Linking word before the affected drug
modes.description: A small word after an interaction verb or noun, just before the affected drug or compounds are named.
modes.example: Griseofulvin has been reported in the literature to interfere with the metabolism<< of>> various compounds.

modes.label: Potentiation verb
modes.description: The start of a word meaning to strengthen another drug's effect.
